verdict.rationale: First-party docs say data teams define models with SQL, tables/views, or existing dbt models (docs-2, docs-23), and marketers build audiences from warehouse data (docs-19). The product runs on top of the warehouse without copying data into a separate system (docs-44), and syncs activate models to 300+ destinations on a schedule or trigger using CDC, optionally computed in-warehouse via Lightning (docs-27, docs-49, docs-58, docs-26). HN comments corroborate the declarative SQL-model syncs and that data stays in the customer's warehouse (comm-2, comm-3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of warehouse-native activation, since the community statements come from the Hightouch cofounder rather than users.
